message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to current air‑quality data. For the most up‑to‑date information on Los Angeles, you can check:

| Source | What it offers |
|--------|----------------|
| **AirNow** (airnow.gov) | Live AQI readings, pollutant breakdowns, and forecast for all U.S. cities |
| **EPA Air Quality Index** | Interactive map and alerts |
| **Local news outlets** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Daily summaries and health advisories |
| **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) | Often include AQI in their forecasts |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also search “Los Angeles AQI” in a search engine or use a voice assistant like Siri or Google Assistant.
